brief.topic: The Curve at the End of a Taut Thread

s01: A small point is pulled by a taut thread.
The other end moves along this straight line.
The trailing point draws a curve as it follows.
In this ideal model, the trailing point moves only along the thread.
Its direction is therefore the direction of the curve at that point.
Pause and look at the thread.
It reaches from the curve to the straight line, and its length stays the same.
This constant tangent length defines a curve called the tractrix.
The trailing point comes closer, while the thread turns toward the direction of travel.
The gap keeps shrinking, but this ideal curve never quite reaches the line at a finite pull distance.
Start again with a thread half as long.
The point begins closer to the line and follows a smaller version of the curve.
At the same pulling distance, it hugs the line more closely.
A different length changes the shape of the journey.

scenes.narration:
A small point is pulled by a taut thread. The other end moves along this straight line. The trailing point draws a curve as it follows.

In this ideal model, the trailing point moves only along the thread. The thread does not stretch. Its direction is therefore the direction of the curve at that point.

Pause and look at the thread. It reaches from the curve to the straight line, and its length stays the same. This constant tangent length defines a curve called the tractrix.

Keep pulling along the line. The trailing point comes closer, while the thread turns toward the direction of travel. The gap keeps shrinking, but this ideal curve never quite reaches the line at a finite pull distance.

Start again with a thread half as long. The point begins closer to the line and follows a smaller version of the curve. At the same pulling distance, it hugs the line more closely. A different length changes the shape of the journey.
